transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. It's nice to meet you too. 

Well, I suppose what finally brought me in today is that... I feel like the part of me that used to reach out to people has just gone very quiet. I used to take a lot of pleasure in my work, doing yoga, visiting galleries, or even just journaling. But lately, I don't really feel that connection. I’m mostly just moving through my obligations right now, just going through the motions.
How long have you been feeling this way?

I'd say it's been about eight months now. It really started right around the time we took my older relative into our apartment to live with us. Ever since then, this whole change in how I’m thinking, how I'm working, and just... connecting with people, it's been going on like this.
Do you feel these changes began because of the stress of your older relative moving in with you?

I mean... I don't really know. I suppose having her move in was a big adjustment, but... I don't feel particularly stressed by it. It's just that the timing lines up. It's more like... the energy I used to have just isn't there anymore, regardless of what's going on around me.
Before these past eight months, had you been feeling down or low most days for at least two years?

No, not at all. Before this started about eight months ago, I was actually doing quite well. I didn't feel down or low like this. I was enjoying my life and my routines. It really just started recently.
Before these past eight months, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed or lost interest in things for at least two weeks?

No, I don't think so. I mean, everyone has a bad few days here and there, but... not for two weeks straight where I just lost interest in everything. Before these last eight months, I was always pretty engaged with my work and my life. So, no, I haven't had a period like that before.
Have you had thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?

No, I haven't. I mean, I know I've been feeling really drained lately, but... no, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself. I don't feel like life isn't worth living. It's just that it takes a lot more effort to get through the day right now.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
No, not really. My concentration has been fine. I can still focus on what I need to do without much of a problem, so... no, I haven't noticed any trouble there.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I don't feel sad or... depressed. Like I mentioned, I just feel really drained, but my actual mood is mostly fine. So no, I wouldn't say I've been feeling down most days.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious or worried a lot lately?

No, I haven't. I don't feel unusually anxious or worried about things. Like I said before, I'm mostly just feeling pretty drained, but my anxiety isn't really an issue right now. It's just my energy levels.
Have you had trouble sleeping?

No, my sleep has been fine, actually. I fall asleep without much of an issue and usually sleep right through the night. I know I keep mentioning how drained I feel during the day, but it doesn't really seem to be connected to how much sleep I'm getting. So, no, no problems there.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?
No, my appetite is pretty much the same. I'm eating normally, three meals a day. I haven't noticed any changes there.
